name: Documentum
description: Connect your own OpenText Documentum repository to browse and manage Cabinets, Folders, Documents, Versions (checkout/checkin), Permissions, Lifecycles, and run a content-health audit.

tools.name: connect_documentum
tools.description: Connect a Documentum repository via base URL, repository name, and username/password.

base_url.description: Documentum REST Services base URL, e.g. 'https://dctm.acme.com:8080/dctm-rest'.
base_url.title: Base Url

username.description: Documentum username with REST access to this repository.
username.title: Username

tools.name: disconnect_documentum
tools.description: Disconnect a saved Documentum repository connection.

connection_id.description: Saved Documentum connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Documentum repositories.

tools.name: list_cabinets
tools.description: List top-level Cabinets in the connected repository.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Read one Documentum object's (folder or document) metadata in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: list_folder_contents
tools.description: List the folders and documents inside a folder or cabinet.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder inside an existing folder or cabinet.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

parent_id.description: Parent folder/cabinet object ID to create the folder inside.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

tools.name: rename_or_move_object
tools.description: Rename an object and/or move it to a new parent folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

name.description: New object name. Leave blank to keep the current name.
name.title: Name

new_parent_id.description: Destination parent folder object ID to move into. Leave blank to keep in place.
new_parent_id.title: New Parent Id

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Permanently delete a folder or document. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Download a document's primary content, base64-encoded.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a new document (base64-encoded content) into a folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

parent_folder_id.description: Folder object ID to upload the document into.
parent_folder_id.title: Parent Folder Id

tools.name: upload_document_version
tools.description: Check in a new version of an existing document (base64-encoded content).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

name.description: File name for this new version.
name.title: Name

tools.name: get_lifecycle_state
tools.description: Read an object's current lifecycle name and state (e.g. Draft, Review, Approved).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: promote_lifecycle
tools.description: Promote an object to the next lifecycle state (e.g. Draft -> Review).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: demote_lifecycle
tools.description: Demote an object to its previous lifecycle state.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: list_permissions
tools.description: List the ACL permission grants (who can see/modify/delete) on an object.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: grant_permission
tools.description: Grant an ACL permission level (e.g. Read, Write, Delete) to a user or group on an object.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

accessor_name.description: User or group name to grant access to.
accessor_name.title: Accessor Name

permission_level.description: Permission level: NONE, BROWSE, READ, RELATE, VERSION, WRITE, or DELETE.
permission_level.title: Permission Level

tools.name: revoke_permission
tools.description: Revoke a user's or group's ACL permission on an object.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

accessor_name.description: User or group name to revoke access from.
accessor_name.title: Accessor Name

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Free-text search across object names and content in the repository.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Free-text search across object names and content, e.g. 'contract 2026'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: search_dql
tools.description: Run a raw Documentum Query Language (DQL) SELECT statement for advanced/precise searches.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

dql.description: Raw Documentum Query Language (DQL) statement, e.g. "SELECT r_object_id, object_name FROM dm_document WHERE folder('/Contracts')".
dql.title: Dql

tools.name: audit_content_health
tools.description: Scan a folder and flag content-health issues: long-checked-out documents, empty documents, and very large files.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Folder or cabinet object ID to audit.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

checkout_days.description: Flag documents checked out longer than this many days.
checkout_days.title: Checkout Days

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the version tree of a document.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: checkout_document
tools.description: Check out a document, locking it for editing by the connected user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a checkout without saving changes, releasing the lock.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Documentum repository connection ID. Omit to use the first connected repository.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_id.description: Documentum object ID (r_object_id), a 16-character hex string.
object_id.title: Object Id

secrets.name: documentum_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Documentum repositories and their username/password (Basic Auth, sent on every request). Managed only through connect_documentum and disconnect_documentum.
